title: Funny Hugh Laurie & Stephen Fry comedy sketch! 'Your name, sir?' - BBC
summary: A classic sketch from A Bit of Fry and Laurie in which a man at a police station has a surname that is very hard to pronounce. Stephen Fry and Hugh Laurie play it out as a comic exchange.
why: HN brings it up as a joke whenever threads touch on long names, name handling or unpronounceable identifiers.
